releases.name: v16.30.0
releases.body:
## Features
* Adds a settings dialog with grouped sections for related options. Adds a sliding on/off toggle for forms and dialogs. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41376)
* Adds the shared features used by CRM and Helpdesk to v16, so those apps can use forms, phone number fields, notifications, and activity history. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41513)
* **Recorder** adds a timeline view for document-related actions and shows how long each step takes and which apps are involved. Administrators can turn on _Capture document lifecycle timeline_ in **Configure Recorder**. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41560)
* Adds a copy button in the About dialog for the installed app versions. Clicking an app entry copies that app’s version, and the entries also work with the keyboard. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41281)

## Bug Fixes
* SQLite now records the last query it runs, so `assertQueryCount` works on that database too. The older copy of `assertQueryCount` also turns the recorded queries into plain text before showing them in a failure message. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41317)
* Restricts **Report** scripts to approved methods and blocks custom document code from using private methods. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41357)
* Google sign-in now saves the return path with the sign-in details, so the response from Google can reach the right step. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41370)
* The **Custom Field** rename action now accepts `POST` requests only. This prevents field names from changing when the page is opened directly. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41404)
* Prevents **File** from resaving an image when optimization leaves it unchanged. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41354)
* Users can open only **Notification Log** entries addressed to them. Administrators can still open all **Notification Log** entries. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41392)
* Downloads additional markup-related file types instead of opening them in the browser. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41386)
* The **SMS Settings** contact lookup now checks that you can view both the **Contact** and the linked document before it shows a phone number. It only shows a phone number when that **Contact** is linked to the document. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41382)
* Viewing another user's **Event** entries now requires the System Manager role. Everyone else sees only their own events. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41380)
* The **File** form checks the file path again before it loads content. This blocks invalid file paths from being used to open file content. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41351)
* Outgoing emails show images only from `assets/`, `files/`, or `private/files/`. Images from other paths no longer appear in the email. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41347)
* The calendar now checks that the selected fields for event start and end exist before it loads events. If one is missing, it shows a clear error instead of a database error. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41345)
* When you run an SQL query in the **System Console**, the result columns appear in the same order as the query. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41131)
* Link fields now show a record’s title only when you have permission to view that record. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41406)
* During setup, your tracking preference now takes effect only after setup completes. Setup steps are still recorded before tracking is turned off. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41408)
* Unpublished **Web Form**s no longer accept submit, delete, list, or form data requests, matching the form’s published status. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41400)
* Bulk submit, cancel, update, and workflow approval actions now accept only `POST` requests. Document title updates use the same rule, so they do not run from a simple page visit or link. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41388)
* Cancelling a document now converts its ID to text before checking related records, preventing a crash for documents that use numeric IDs. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41411)
* Adds a check so only users who can view a **Prepared Report** can export it as CSV. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41384)
* Adds permission filtering to **Tag Link** so list and report results show only tags on doctypes the current user can read. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41396)
* Restricts **Dashboard Settings** so only the user it belongs to can open it, while **Administrator** remains an exception. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41394)
* The app now uses a backup format for very large numbers when needed, so some pages no longer show an error. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41310)
* The follow and unfollow actions for documents now apply only to your signed-in account. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41402)
* Updates **Communication** relink search to use the same list of document types on screen and behind the scenes, so it only shows options you can open. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41432)
* Long page titles in the header now shorten with an ellipsis, keeping the action buttons visible instead of pushing them off-screen. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41456)
* Incoming **Communication** emails now link to the right document even when the document type name uses different capitalization. This keeps the related record attached to the email. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41494)
* Permission errors for child rows now name the parent document instead of the row itself. This makes it clear which document the missing permission applies to. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41495)
* Regional language packs now keep their own translations even when apps are installed in a different order. This keeps regional wording from being replaced by another app’s base-language text. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41501)
* Restores the notification indicator in **Desk** and adds an unread count to the sidebar. The count updates as new notifications arrive, and marking notifications as read now happens in one step. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41482)
* Limits contact form submissions to 100 per hour from the same IP address and adds a _Send Acknowledgement Email_ option in **Contact Us Settings** to turn the automatic reply on or off. The acknowledgement email now contains only a short thank-you message and no longer includes the submitted message. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41512)
* Bulk delete now returns the records that could not be deleted, and the list only removes records that were actually deleted. This keeps failed deletions and deletions scheduled for later visible in the list. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41524)
* Removes deleted records and updates renamed records in the app’s copy, so old names and deleted entries no longer appear after the change. When records are merged, the remaining record keeps its existing details. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41530)
* Limits the requests used to get, revoke, or check tokens to `POST`, while the UserInfo endpoint accepts `GET` and `POST`. This blocks other request types from these endpoints. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41554)
* Reloads the app list used during installation when the app is not already listed. This avoids installation failures caused by outdated app information. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41438)
* Exporting **DocType** or **Page** as fixtures now shows an error, since these items are meant to be created from the Desk in developer mode. This avoids fixture files that fail when they are imported later. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41445)
* Adds the _Sync In Batches_ setting in **System Settings** so you can choose whether data is copied to DuckDB in batches or all at once. It also removes older **DuckDB Sync** records after 45 days. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41558)
* Keeps the form menu available when the sidebar is turned off in **Form Settings**. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41492)
* Marks **Recorder Event** as virtual, so app updates do not attempt to create a separate empty table for it. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41566)
* Sends the **User Invitation** expiry email to the invited person instead of the person who sent the invite. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41567)
* Comments in the document timeline now expand to the full width when the full-width setting is turned on. The "Load more" area matches the same width instead of staying narrow. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41297)
* Print formats linked to a document type now stay separate from the **Print Format** form, so a refresh keeps the version already open instead of replacing it with the stored copy. Print preview and email composer also read that separate copy when choosing a format. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41552)
* Updates **File** folder links so nested folders open with the correct folder path, and the breadcrumb no longer shows `undefined`. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41580)
* Fixes record lookups that return just one value so the result stays intact instead of splitting into letters or failing on numbers. Hidden values in those results still show as `XXXXXXXX` for users without permission to see them. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41584)

## Other Changes
* Report View exports now use the saved names for linked records again instead of the titles shown in the report. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41336)

**Authors**: @barredterra, @ankush, @iamejaaz, @nextchamp-saqib, @tanmoysrt, @netchampfaris, @Bowrna, @KerollesFathy, @Vibhuti410, @kaulith, @diptanilsaha, @ruthra-kumar, @RitvikSardana, @Shllokkk, @ShrihariMahabal, @nishkagosalia

releases.body:
## Features
* Autocomplete dropdowns now also search within option descriptions, letting you find items by typing words that appear in their description. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41360)
* Adds the shared features used by CRM and Helpdesk to v16, so those apps can use forms, phone number fields, notifications, and activity history. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41517)

## Bug Fixes
* Restricts **Report** scripts to approved methods and blocks custom document code from using private methods. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41356)
* Link fields now show a record’s title only when you have permission to view that record. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41405)
* The **Custom Field** rename action now accepts `POST` requests only. This prevents field names from changing when the page is opened directly. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41403)
* Prevents **File** from resaving an image when optimization leaves it unchanged. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41353)
* Users can open only **Notification Log** entries addressed to them. Administrators can still open all **Notification Log** entries. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41391)
* The **File** form checks the file path again before it loads content. This blocks invalid file paths from being used to open file content. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41350)
* Outgoing emails show images only from `assets/`, `files/`, or `private/files/`. Images from other paths no longer appear in the email. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41346)
* Downloads additional markup-related file types instead of opening them in the browser. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41385)
* Adds a check so only users who can view a **Prepared Report** can export it as CSV. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41383)
* Bulk submit, cancel, update, and workflow approval actions now accept only `POST` requests. Document title updates use the same rule, so they do not run from a simple page visit or link. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41387)
* Cancelling a document now converts its ID to text before checking related records, preventing a crash for documents that use numeric IDs. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41410)
* Viewing another user's **Event** entries now requires the System Manager role. Everyone else sees only their own events. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41379)
* Restricts **Dashboard Settings** so only the user it belongs to can open it, while **Administrator** remains an exception. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41393)
* Unpublished **Web Form**s no longer accept submit, delete, list, or form data requests, matching the form’s published status. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41399)
* Updates **Communication** relink search to use the same list of document types on screen and behind the scenes, so it only shows options you can open. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41431)
* Collapsible sections you open stay open as you edit fields, including in table rows. This keeps the field you're editing visible while you type. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41414)
* Bulk delete now returns the records that could not be deleted, and the list only removes records that were actually deleted. This keeps failed deletions and deletions scheduled for later visible in the list. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41523)
* Removes deleted records and updates renamed records in the app’s copy, so old names and deleted entries no longer appear after the change. When records are merged, the remaining record keeps its existing details. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41529)
* Limits contact form submissions to 100 per hour from the same IP address and adds a _Send Acknowledgement Email_ option in **Contact Us Settings** to turn the automatic reply on or off. The acknowledgement email now contains only a short thank-you message and no longer includes the submitted message. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41511)
* Limits the requests used to get, revoke, or check tokens to `POST`, while the UserInfo endpoint accepts `GET` and `POST`. This blocks other request types from these endpoints. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41553)
* Fixes a DuckDB sync error caused by an invalid parameter. Adds options to sync data all at once or in batches, with a cleanup option that can be turned on or off. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41480)
* Regional language packs now keep their own translations even when apps are installed in a different order. This keeps regional wording from being replaced by another app’s base-language text. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41500)
* Keeps the form menu available when the sidebar is turned off in **Form Settings**. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41491)
* Print formats linked to a document type now stay separate from the **Print Format** form, so a refresh keeps the version already open instead of replacing it with the stored copy. Print preview and email composer also read that separate copy when choosing a format. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41551)
* Updates **File** folder links so nested folders open with the correct folder path, and the breadcrumb no longer shows `undefined`. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41579)
* Fixes a v15 update problem that could prevent the site from loading after an upgrade, and keeps existing notification email preferences from being reset. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41577)

## Other Changes
* Exports from reports keep linked values in their stored form instead of replacing them with the linked record’s display name. (https://github.com/frappe/frappe/pull/41335)

**Authors**: @ruthra-kumar, @diptanilsaha, @ankush, @ShrihariMahabal, @barredterra, @ps173, @RitvikSardana, @kaulith
**Reviewers**: @ruthra-kumar, @sokumon, @NagariaHussain, @barredterra, @iamejaaz, @sagarvora, @RitvikSardana, @surajshetty3416, @ankush

## 版本信息 | **项目** | **描述** | |----------|-----------------| | 发布日期 | 2026-08-06 | | 版本号 | V5.0.1_CE | | Commit 号 | [071f4d9c82841d3ecb2d0004ef9213766308b714](https://github.com/oceanbase/oceanbase/releases/tag/v5.0.1_CE)| | RPM 版本号 | oceanbase-ce_5.0.1.0-100000012026072916 | ## 版本概览 OceanBase 数据库 V5.0.1 是 OceanBase 数据库 V4.6.0 的延续版本，持续对数据库的能力进行完善，其中包括： * DDL 能力增强： * 新增支持加列、删列以及分区操作的并行 DDL。 * 支持列存转行存、行列混存转行存的延迟在线 DDL，从而完善了行存、列存以及行列混存三种存储格式的相互 Online 转换。 * 新增支持表模式（`partial_update`、`delete_insert` 和 `append_only`）在线切换；且增强了 Compaction TTL 能力，支持定义用户列为 TTL 列，且支持 `partial_update` 表定义 TTL 属性，能覆盖更多的业务场景。 * 新增支持创建随机分布表，在数据写入时自动均匀打散到集群各节点，无需用户自定义分区，系统会自动切换，提升易用性。 * 负载均衡能力的增强：新增支持 Zone 级表组和 `SUBPARTITION` 表组，更多维度的控制分区的聚集和均衡策略。 * 对物化视图功能从监控诊断、增量刷新性能和使用易用性以及功能稳定性全方面做了能力提升。 * AI 能力上，AI Function 支持对图片类型的处理，并且做了并发请求的优化。 * 新增内置 `IK` 分词器现支持加载用户自定义词典，提升全文索引的准确性。 * 提供了 Database 级资源隔离（CPU/IO）的能力，允许将每个 Database 映射到独立的资源组，实现 CPU 和 IO 的细粒度隔离。 ## 关键特性说明 ### 特性增强 * SUBPARTITION 表组 新增 `SHARDING = 'SUBPARTITION'` 属性，支持跨一级分区的二级分区对齐。具有相同二级分区键值的数据绑定到同一日志流，全局索引与主表二级分区隐式绑定，提升二级分区维度的事务性能和本地化率。表组内所有表的一级分区和二级分区类型、数量、边界必须完全一致。 更多详细信息，参见 [表组概述](https://www.oceanbase.com/docs/common-oceanbase-database-cn-1000000006616404)。 * 支持 Zone 级表组（TableGroup） Zone 级表组支持将相关分区按规则聚集在同一个 Zone 内，并使表组内分区 Leader 均匀分布在 Zone 内不同 OBServer 上。解决现有表组 `Sharding = None` 因为数据总量过大而无法用单台 OBServer 承载全部分区数据，`Sharding = Partition/Adaptive` 无法控制分区 Leader 分布而导致性能受限的问题。通过新增 `SCOPE` 属性控制分区 Leader 分布方式，原 `SHARDING` 属性继续用于控制分区聚集与均衡策略。 更多详细信息，参见 [表组概述](https://www.oceanbase.com/docs/common-oceanbase-database-cn-1000000006616404)。 * 随机分布表 新增随机分布表功能，数据写入时自动均匀打散到集群各节点，每个日志流维护一个活跃分区，彻底规避热点分区问题，适合无主键、高写入吞吐的宽表场景。语法为 `CREATE TABLE t (...) PARTITION BY RANDOM [SIZE('size_value')]`，通过 `SIZE` 参数指定单个分区的目标大小，超出后自动分裂。 更多详细信息，参见 [随机分布表概述](https://www.oceanbase.com/docs/common-oceanbase-database-cn-1000000006619147)。 * Compaction TTL 支持用户列 在原有基于 `ora_rowscn` 的 TTL 之外，支持使用 `DATETIME`、`TIMESTAMP` 或 `DATE` 类型的用户列作为 `TTL` 列，结合 `Compaction` 触发数据过期清理。语法为 `CREATE TABLE t (...) TTL = ts + INTERVAL 30 DAY BY COMPACTION`，也可通过 `ALTER TABLE` 为已有表追加 `TTL` 属性。对于表模式为 `partial_update` 的表，支持以主键列或 `ROWSCN` 作为 `TTL` 列。 更多详细信息，参见 [使用 TTL（Time To Live）功能](https://www.oceanbase.com/docs/common-oceanbase-database-cn-1000000006615973)。 * 列存转行存操作支持异步 Online DDL 在 OceanBase 数据库 V4.3.5 版本已支持了行存表在线转换为列存表，但是列存表转为行存表是 Offline DDL，会阻塞业务DML，OceanBase 数据库 V5.0.1 版本支持通过在线 DDL 方式列存与行存、行列混存三种存储模式间切换，用户在执行 DDL 语句时只需指定关键字 `delayed`，即可实时修改表的 Schema 信息，而不会阻塞数据写入，对业务读写影响降到最低，基线数据存储格式重整将在基线数据合并时异步执行。 * 表模式 Online 转换 为了方便业务基于不同需求，在不同表模式之间切换，如：为了提升增量数据场景下的列存表查询性能，需要将表模式修改为 `delete_insert`。支持在三种表模式（`partial_update`、`delete_insert` 以及 `append_only`）之间 Online 切换，避免业务重建表。 * Parquet Page 级别预取优化 将 Parquet 外表读取的预取粒度从 Row Group 级别细化到 Page 级别，仅预取被访问列的相关 Page。引入 Page Index 缓存，避免重复解析 Parquet Footer，根据过滤条件动态调整预取队列深度。Parquet 外表扫描 IO 放大降低 40%~60%，高选择性查询端到端延迟下降 30% 以上。 * Catalog 外表采样 支持对 Catalog 外表（如 Hive、Iceberg 等数据源的外部表）执行统计信息采样，通过 `DBMS_STATS.GATHER_CATALOG_TABLE_STATS` 采集外表统计信息，优化器可据此生成更优的执行计划，提升跨源联邦查询性能。 更多详细信息，参见 [GATHER_CATALOG_TABLE_STATS](https://www.oceanbase.com/docs/common-oceanbase-database-cn-1000000006619709)。 * 外表易用性 OceanBase 的外表 Pattern 实现行为是正则写法，常常被误以为 Pattern 是 GLOB 写法。本版本对外表相关命令（CREATE/ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE、LOAD DATA FROM FILES()、INSERT INTO FROM FILES（）等）新增 REGEXP_PATTERN 和 GLOB_PATTERN 子句，且为了兼容老版本的行为，还会保留正则匹配的 Pattern 语法。为了提升用户体验，统一函数命名风格，新增支持CATALOG()，其功能与 CURRENT_CATALOG() 完全等价。 * 并行 DDL * 加列/删列：支持多张表同时执行 `ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN` 和 `ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN`，表间并行执行，同一张表内仍为串行。加列与删列混用、加自增列、加存储生成列、删列带索引等场景自动退化为串行执行。 * 分区操作：支持多张表并行执行分区级 DDL，包括 `ADD PARTITION`、`DROP PARTITION`、`TRUNCATE PARTITION` 及对应的子分区操作。表间并行，同一张表内通过表级 `EXCLUSIVE` 锁保证串行。 * 物化视图能力增强 * 监控和诊断增强：刷新监控信息的 `purge` 从按每个物化视图（以下简称 MV）各自保留时间逐条清理优化为所有 MV 统一保留时间批量清理，降低 SQL 次数与开销；支持在物化视图刷新过程中分阶段实时持久化，支持在刷新过程中观测刷新进度。扩展监控视图展示。新增 `DBMS_MVIEW.REFRESH_REPORT(refresh_id, mv_name, tenant_id, format)` 过程，一键获取物化视图刷新任务执行报告，包含刷新类型、耗时、异常原因等关键信息。 * 增量刷新性能和易用性优化：支持自适应快速刷新，多表 MV 增量刷新时自动识别无 DML 变更的基表并跳过对应步骤；所有基表均无变更时仅更新刷新元数据，视为空刷新，降低无效刷新开销。新增语法定义物化视图的 `refresh parallel`，与物化视图的查询并行度区分，可独立定义物化视图的刷新并行度。支持在聚合、`JOIN`、`UNION` 等场景下，增量刷新时系统自动推导依赖列，无需手动指定依赖列降低定义物化视图的难度，让用户更易上手。增强 MLOG 自动管理，`DROP MV` 时若 MLOG 未被其他 MV 依赖，对应的 MLOG 也会一并删除，不需要用户手动删除。无论是否开启自动 MLOG 管理，删除基表时会自动级联删除不再被任何 MV 使用的 MLOG。 * 刷新调度能力增强：重构了物化视图刷新任务的调度框架，从旧版同步串行调度升级为异步任务队列模式。新框架支持按优先级排队、控制最大并发刷新任务数（`mv_refresh_concurrency`，默认为 10），避免了大量物化视图同时刷新时的资源争抢和调度阻塞，用户可根据租户内物化视图数量和业务负载调整并发度。`DBMS_MVIEW.REFRESH` 支持通过 `async` 参数指定刷新任务为异步任务，默认情况下 `DBMS_MVIEW.REFRESH` 阻塞直至刷新完成。并且新增支持 `DBMS_MVIEW.KILL_REFRESH(mview_name)` 过程：可取消正在运行的物化视图刷新任务，适用于刷新任务长时间阻塞或需要紧急释放系统资源的场景。 * SCHEMA HISTORY 回收优化 新增 `package`、`routine`、`ols`、`udt` 对象回收，减少历史记录过多对 Schema 刷新性能的影响；优化回收性能并将回收任务改为租户级调度管理。 * 系统视图查询 SQL/PL 保留字 新增系统视图 `V$OB_KEYWORDS`，可查询 SQL 和 PL 的全量关键字列表，便于迁移评估和应用排查。 ### 兼容性增强 * 表达式增强 新增和修复多项内置函数。包括： * 新增表达式：`NCHR`、`INSTR`、`ROUND`、`randCanonical`、`parseDateTime`。 * 新增聚合函数：`avgWeighted`、`string_agg`。 * 优化表达式性能：`json_extract`、`json_seek`、`json_length`、`json_type`、`ifnull`、`space`、`extract` 以及 `date_format`。 * MySQL 5.7/8.0 默认字符集字符序兼容 通过设置 `ob_compatibility_control = 'MYSQL8.0'`，当仅指定 `utf8mb4` 而未写 `collation` 时，默认 `collation` 为 `utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci`。在升级到 V5.0.1 版本前已创建的库表，默认 `collation` 仍为升级前规则；升级后新建租户指定 `MYSQL8.0` 才按 `MYSQL8.0` 默认。仅新建租户时指定，创建租户后不能修改。 ### 性能优化 * 中等规模并行优化 在约 4000 DOP 的中等规模并行场景中，并行框架调度队列分层减少线程竞争，数据重分布阶段引入批量发送降低消息频率，优化 PX Worker 的 CPU 亲和性分配减少跨 `NUMA` 访问。中等规模并行（DOP 2000–6000）场景 AP 查询吞吐提升 15%~30%。 * ARM AP 性能优化 补充 `ARM NEON SIMD` 向量化实现（整数运算、字符串比较、哈希计算），优化内存预取策略适配 ARM 的 Cache Line 行为，针对 ARM 编译器调整内联汇编与编译选项。ARM 平台 AP 核心算子性能提升 20%~40%，整体 TPC-H 性能接近 x86 水平。 * SQL 执行技改 多项算子和执行路径优化。`HashDistinct` 接入自适应状态机，根据数据量动态选择 `Hash` 或 `Sort` 去重策略；`Partition Sort` 优化利用分区有序性减少排序代价；补充 `Window Function`、`CASE WHEN` 等算子的向量化路径；聚合下推增强更多场景将聚合下推到存储层执行；列裁剪增强精确裁剪复杂视图嵌套场景下未被使用的列。 * 外键 GTS 优化 引入外键检查的批量 GTS 获取，合并多次 GTS 请求为单次，减少 RPC 开销；且对只读外键路径（`SELECT` 时外键校验）绕过 GTS 获取，优化外键元数据缓存，减少重复解析开销。含外键场景写入 TPS 提升 15%~25%。 * PL 性能优化 PL 编译缓存增强，扩大编译产物缓存减少重复编译；编译器对小循环体执行循环展开优化；局部变量寄存器化减少内存访问；`BULK COLLECT` 批量 `FETCH` 减少内存重分配次数；匿名块多次执行时复用编译结果。PL 密集型负载性能提升 10%~25%。 * TopN 保序与漏斗函数 非并行场景下 `ORDER BY ... LIMIT N` 场景保留排序稳定性，对相同排序键的行保持输入顺序。新增 `window_funnel` 聚合函数，支持用户行为路径分析（事件序列匹配），适用于电商转化率、留存率分析场景。 * 嵌套子查询提升增强 OceanBase 数据库 V5.0.1 版本可启用更激进的嵌套子查询提升规则，将更多相关子查询转化为 `JOIN`。 * SPM 支持 PL 内 SQL SQL Plan Management 的基线捕获与计划演进功能扩展到 PL 内嵌 SQL，存储过程、函数、Package 中的 SQL 均可纳入 SPM 管理。 * SubPlan Filter 计划优化 引入 `BC2HOST NONE` 分布式算法和参数化缓存，减少相关子查询的跨节点 RPC 和重复执行开销。 * 迁移批量创建 Tablet 引入批量 Tablet 创建接口，单次 RPC 支持批量传输 Tablet 元数据，优化 Tablet 元数据的序列化格式，降低单 Tablet 网络开销。百万级 Tablet 场景下迁移初始化阶段耗时降低 50%~70%。 ### AI 与全文搜索 * AI Function 支持图片与并发 为了满足业务对图片处理的需求，扩展 AI Function 表达式能力，支持对图片类型数据（Base64 或 URL）调用 AI 接口生成向量，`AI_EMBED`/`AI_PROMPT`/`AI_COMPLETE` 支持图片类型数据，与文本向量统一存储和搜索；AI Function 支持多路并发请求外部 AI 接口，在注册或修改端点时可通过 `min_concurrency`、`max_concurrency` 参数以控制批量请求的并发度，显著提升批量向量化、批量推断场景的吞吐。 * JSON 表达式性能优化 优化 `JSON_EXTRACT`、`JSON_VALUE` 等 JSON 提取表达式的执行路径，减少 JSON 解析、数据拷贝和 LOB 访问开销，提升 JSON 字段查询性能。 ### 隔离与基础设施 * 基于 Database 的资源隔离 面向 SaaS 多租户场景，为了避免部分用户对资源进行争抢影响其他用户访问 `database`，提供了 `database` 级资源隔离（CPU 隔离）的能力，允许将每个 Database 映射到独立的资源组，实现 CPU 和 IO 的细粒度隔离。租户规格不低于 16C64G，单租户最多支持 1000 个资源组。 资源隔离优先级为：SQL 级 **Hint > Database 级 > User 级 > Function** 级。Database 级别资源隔离功能依赖 OBProxy V4.4.1。 * 龙芯 CPU 兼容 OceanBase 数据库 V5.0.1 正式支持龙芯（LoongArch64）处理器架构，为国产化信创场景提供原生支持。支持龙芯 3A6000 及以上系列处理器，适配 Loongnix、统信 UOS（龙芯版）操作系统。 * 内核支持 Cgroup V2 支持 Linux Cgroup V2，适配使用新内核的国产操作系统（欧拉 EulerOS、麒麟 KylinOS、统信 UOS 等）。OBServer 启动时自动检测当前系统 Cgroup 版本并使用对应接口，无需额外配置。要求 Linux 内核版本 ≥ 5.10。 ### 安全与可靠性增强 * 双密码管理 解决企业级数据库运维中修改应用账号密码可能导致连接中断的问题。OceanBase 数据库 V5.0.1 版本开始支持数据库账号改密时，允许在过渡期内新旧密码同时有效，避免批量改密导致应用瞬时全部断连；待应用切换完成后再废弃旧密码。支持 `ALTER USER ... IDENTIFIED BY 'new' RETAIN CURRENT PASSWORD`，新旧密码在滚动升级期间均有效。 * 审计功能增强 细化审计过滤器，支持命令级、对象级审计。两种模式下均新增审计日志加密功能。 * 日志归档启停性能优化 缩短归档开启和停止过程中的等待时间。适用于频繁执行归档启停。 * 备份任务磁盘满行为优化 备份任务在执行过程中，目标服务器磁盘空间不足备份任务会直接失败，为降低备份任务失败的频率，备份调度前服务器磁盘水位已超过预设阈值的情况将不会被选择执行备份任务；且备份执行过程中的出现磁盘满情况可控重试。 * Transfer 稳定性增强 增强 transfer 相关流程的稳定性，优化部分任务推进和异常处理场景，降低 transfer 过程中出现任务长时间等待或临时失败的概率。 * 密码计算和验证 OceanBase 数据库支持通过 `caching_sha2_password` 认证插件来控制密码的哈希计算和验证方式。 ## 产品行为变更 ### 语法、函数与协议变更 | **类型** | **名称/语法** | **变更说明** | |----------|---------------|--------------| | SQL 语法 | `CREATE TABLE ... PARTITION BY RANDOM [SIZE('n')]` | 创建随机分布表，数据按分区大小自动分裂。| | SQL 语法 | `TTL = + INTERVAL N DAY BY COMPACTION` | 支持用户列作为 TTL 基准列，结合 Compaction 触发过期清理。| | DDL | `ALTER TABLE table_name DROP COLUMN GROUP ([all columns,][each column]) [ delayed ];` | 在线 DDL 切换表存储模式。| | DDL | `ALTER TABLE table_name SET MERGE_ENGINE = {partial_update \| delete_insert \| append_only};` | 在线 DDL 切换表模式。| | DDL | `CREATE TABLEGROUP ... SHARDING = 'SUBPARTITION'` | 创建二级分区对齐的表组。| | DDL | `CREATE TABLEGROUP ... SCOPE = 'ZONE' / 'SERVER' / 'CLUSTER'` | 创建指定 Leader 范围的表组。| | 函数 | `DBMS_BALANCE.SET_TABLEGROUP_BALANCE_WEIGHT()` | 设置表组在 Zone 间的均衡权重。| | 函数 | `DBMS_IK.ADD_CUSTOM_DICT() / DBMS_IK.RELOAD_DICT()` | 管理 `IK` 分词器自定义词典。| | 函数 | `DBMS_MVIEW.REFRESH_REPORT()` | 查询物化视图刷新任务执行报告。| | 函数 | `DBMS_MVIEW.KILL_REFRESH()` | 取消正在运行的物化视图刷新任务。| | 函数 | `DBMS_STATS.GATHER_TABLE_STATS()`（外表）| 采集外表统计信息。| | 函数 | `JSON_ARRAYAGG(... ORDER BY ...)` | `JSON` 数组聚合时支持内部排序。| | 函数 | `FUNNEL_COUNT()`/`FUNNEL_PATH()` | 用户行为路径分析漏斗函数。| | 认证 | `ALTER USER ... RETAIN CURRENT PASSWORD` | 双密码管理，新旧密码滚动升级期间均有效。| | 认证 | `ALTER USER ... DISCARD OLD PASSWORD` | 显式废弃旧密码，仅新密码有效。| | 认证 | `ALTER USER ... IDENTIFIED BY 'new'` | 仅保留新密码，旧密码立即失效。| | SQL 语法 | `ALTER TENANT tenant_name DEFAULT TABLESPACE tablespace_name;` | 修改租户的 `DEFAULT TABLESPACE`。| | SQL 语法 | `CREATE DATABASE database_name [DEFAULT TABLESPACE tablespace_name];` | 创建 database 时指定 `DEFAULT TABLESPACE`。| | SQL 语法 | `ALTER DATABASE database_name DEFAULT TABLESPACE tablespace_name;` | 修改 database 的 `DEFAULT TABLESPACE`。| | PL包 | `DBMS_SCHEMA` | 新增系统包 `DBMS_SCHEMA`，用于提供 Schema 相关接口，支持子程序：`RECYCLE_SCHEMA_HISTORY()`。| | 函数 | `window_funnel(window, mode, timestamp, cond1, cond2, ..., condN)` | 新增漏斗分析聚合函数，用于计算在指定时间窗口内按顺序满足条件的最大步骤数。| | SQL 语法 | `CREATE TABLEGROUP table_name SHARDING = 'SUBPARTITION';` | 新增创建 `SHARDING` 方式为 `SUBPARTITION` 的表组。| | SQL 语法 | `ALTER SYSTEM REFRESH FULLTEXT DICT db.table` | 自定义词典表在租户内生效。| | SQL 语法 | `CREATE TABLE [IF NOT EXISTS] table_name ('word' VARCHAR NOT NULL COMMENT 'dict entry', PRIMARY KEY ('word')) FULLTEXT_DICT = 'Y'` | 创建自定义词典表，租户内可见。| | 函数 | `CATALOG()` | 查看当前 Catalog 环境，其功能与 `CURRENT_CATALOG()` 完全等价。| | SQL 语法 | 外表相关语句中新增 `REGEXP_PATTERN` 和 `GLOB_PATTERN` 子句 | 为外表相关语句增加 GLOB Pattern 匹配能力，同时保留对正则匹配的支持。| | SQL语法 | `CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_name REFRESH xxx PARALLEL n;` | 创建物化视图时指定刷新并行度。| | SQL语法 | `ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_name REFRESH PARALLEL n;` | 修改物化视图的刷新并行度。| ### 配置项变更 | **配置项** | **变更类型** | **变更说明** | |------------|--------------|--------------| | mv_refresh_concurrency | 新增 | 控制物化视图刷新任务的最大并发数，取值范围 [1, +∞)。| | ai_function_max_concurrency | 新增 | 控制 AI Function 并发请求外部 AI 接口的最大并发数。| | audit_log_encryption | 新增 | 指定审计日志的所使用的加密算法，取值支持：`NONE`/`AES`。| | schema_history_expire_time | 生效级别 | 修改配置项生效范围：从集群级配置项变更为租户级，控机制 schema history 过期时间。| | schema_history_recycle_interval | 废弃 | 废弃 schema history 回收调度间隔的配置。| | schema_history_archive_expire_time | 新增 | 新增租户级配置项，默认值为 0，用于控制归档表的保留时间。| | function_round_dialect | 新增 | 新增租户级配置项，默认值为 MySQL，该配置项用于控制 `ROUND` 函数的语义模式。| ### 视图变更 | **视图名** | **变更类型** | **说明** | |------------|--------------|----------| | V$OB_KEYWORDS | 新增视图 | 展示 SQL 和 PL 的全量保留字列表，含 `IS_RESERVED` 列标识是否为保留字。| | [G]V$OB_SANDBOX_PROCESS | 新增视图 | 展示外部语言独立子进程的运行状态和资源使用情况。| | DBA_MVIEW_RUNNING_JOBS/CDB_MVIEW_RUNNING_JOBS | 新增字段 | 展示当前运行中的物化视图刷新任务，含 `SVR_IP`、`SVR_PORT`、`TABLE_NAME`、`JOB_TYPE`、`SESSION_ID`、`READ_SNAPSHOT`、`PARALLEL`、`JOB_START_TIME`、`REFRESH_ID` 九列，支持同时展示旧版 MDS 引擎和新版 Pending Task 引擎的运行中刷新任务信息。| | DBA_MVREF_CHANGE_STATS/CDB_MVREF_CHANGE_STATS | 新增字段 | 展示物化视图刷新相关的统计信息，新增字段，表示该变更记录所属的重试批次 ID。| | DBA_MVREF_RUN_STATS/CDB_MVREF_RUN_STATS | 新增/修改字段 | 展示物化视图的每次刷新运行的信息，新增字段 `RESULT`、`MVIEW_ID`、`MVIEW_NAME`、`DATA_TARGET_SCN`、`TRACE_ID`，并修改字段 `ELAPSED_TIME` 和 `LOG_PURGE_TIME` 的单位，从秒修改为微妙。| | DBA_MVREF_STATS/CDB_MVREF_STATS | 新增/修改字段 | 展示物化视图刷新的基本计时统计信息，新增字段 `NUM_STEPS`、`RESULT`、`REFRESH_SCN`、`SVR_IP`、`SVR_PORT`，并修改字段 `ELAPSED_TIME` 和 `LOG_PURGE_TIME` 的单位，从秒修改为微妙。| | DBA_MVREF_STMT_STATS/CDB_MVREF_STMT_STATS | 新增/修改字段 | 描述刷新语句关联的信息，新增字段：`RETRY_ID`、`START_TIME`、`RESULT`、`PARALLELISM`，并修改字段 `EXECUTION_TIME` 的单位，从秒修改为微妙。| | DBA_MVIEW_DEPS | 新增视图 | 展示物化视图的依赖关系，含 `MVIEW_OWNER`、`MVIEW_NAME`、`DEP_OWNER`、`DEP_NAME`、`DEP_TYPE` 五列，便于分析物化视图的基表依赖链。| | CDB_MVIEW_DEPS | 新增视图 | CDB 级物化视图依赖关系视图，与 `DBA_MVIEW_DEPS` 列结构一致。| | DBA_TABLES/CDB_TABLES | 新增列 | 补充 OceanBase 数据库表级存储属性，包括行列存属性、压缩算法以及表模式等信息。| | DBA_IK_CUSTOM_DICTS | 新增视图 | 展示当前已加载的 `IK` 分词器自定义词典信息。| | DBA_OB_ROOTSERVICE_EVENT_HISTORY | 新增列 | 新增 `OLD_VALUE`（通过 `NAME4`/`VALUE4` 展示），记录配置项修改前旧值。`EVENT='admin_set_config'` 时，`NAME4='old_value'`。| | DBA_OB_TENANTS | 新增列 | 新增 `default_tablespace` 列，展示租户的默认表空间名。| | DBA_OB_DATABASES/CDB_OB_DATABASES | 新增列 | 新增 `default_tablespace` 列，展示 database 的默认表空间名。| | DBA_OB_USERS/CDB_OB_USERS | 新增列 | 视图新增列 `old_password` 和 `old_password_start_time`，用于记录旧密码的密文和旧密码开始作为 “旧密码” 生效的时间。| | mysql.user | 新增列 | 系统视图新增 `user_attributes` 列，记录用户扩展属性，`JSON` 格式。用于兼容 MySQL 8.0。| | DBA_USERS 和 USER_USERS | 修改字段取值 | 修改 `ACCOUNT_STATUS` 字段的计算逻辑。新增 `OPEN & IN ROLLOVER` 状态，表示账户正常且处于密码轮转期，新旧密码均可使用。| | GV$OB_TENANT_WORKER_GROUPS | 新增视图 | 对外提供租户工作线程组状态的查询能力。| | DBA_OB_EXTERNAL_TAB_STATISTICS | 新增视图 | 用于查询外部收集统计表级统计详情的视图。| | DBA_OB_EXTERNAL_TAB_COL_STATISTICS | 新增视图 | 用于查询外部收集统计列级统计详情的视图。| | DBA_OB_EXTERNAL_PART_COL_STATISTICS | 新增视图 | 用于查询外部收集统计分区列级统计详情的视图。| | DBA_SCHEDULER_RUNNING_JOBS | 新增视图 | 展示租户下正在运行的所有 Job。| | CDB_SCHEDULER_RUNNING_JOBS | 新增视图 | 展示所有租户下正在运行的所有 Job。| | CDB_SCHEDULER_JOBS | 新增视图 | 展示所有租户下的所有 Job。| | CDB_OB_SYS_VARIABLE_HISTORY | 新增视图 | 展示所有租户的系统变量的历史变更。| | DBA_OB_SYS_VARIABLE_HISTORY | 新增视图 | 展示当前租户的系统变量的历史变更。| ## 已知限制与使用注意事项 * V5.0.1 版本不支持共享存储模式。 * Database 资源隔离需 OBProxy V4.4.1：Database 级别的资源隔离功能依赖 OBProxy V4.4.1，在此之前仅 SQL 级 Hint、User 级、Function 级隔离可用。 * 并行 DDL 为隐藏特性：生产环境开启并行 DDL 前请在测试环境充分验证。 * Zone 级表组修改 `SCOPE` 属性后可能触发 Leader 迁移：建议在业务低峰期执行。 * 租户克隆：禁止对主租户执行租户克隆操作，备租户克隆功能为实验特性，依赖租户克隆的场景需先确认使用边界，需知晓功能风险；如已使用主租户克隆功能的用户请联系 OceanBase 数据库技术人员进行风险评估。 ## 升级说明 建议按以下路径升级至 V5.0.1 版本： * V4.6.0 至 V5.0.1 版本（平滑升级）。 * V4.3.5/V4.3.5 BP1~BP2/V4.3.4/V4.3.3/V4.3.2/V4.3.1/V4.3.0（除 RC1）至 V5.0.1（仅限 POC 和测试环境，存在一定风险；如升级遇到问题，环境可能需要重建）。 * V4.2.x 系列及更低版本不支持升级至 V5.0.1 版本。 * 如果 V4.2.x 系列要升级至 V5.0.1 版本，建议 V4.2.x 版本先升级至 V4.3.x 系列，再评估是否可升级至 V5.0.1。 * 共享存储模式不支持升级至 V5.0.1 版本。 ## 周边配套 OceanBase 数据库 V5.0.1 版本推荐使用的平台工具版本如下： | **组件** | **配套版本** | |-------------|--------------| | ODP | V4.3.6.4

releases.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at bf0e1e9cd7426537be5bfbc97ca55f7b3e3e8d2d -->

## What's Changed
### Exciting New Features ✨
* feat(expression): range-sensitive monotonicity for index pruning by @zhang2014 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20241
* feat(query): fused TopN operator with runtime scan filters by @zhang2014 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20247
* feat(query): propagate column statistics through UNION ALL by @forsaken628 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20224
* feat(query): Materialized View support refresh with CHANGE_TRACKING by @b41sh in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20213
* feat(fuse): add hash-distributed partition writes by @KKould in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20216
* feat(query): add 'change$row_id' as an internal column by @zhyass in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20251
* feat: avoid deserialization in bitmap_contains/min/max/has_any/has_all by @harry-hao in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20210
* feat(query): derive sort and window statistics by @sundy-li in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20248
* feat(fuse): support ALTER TABLE PARTITION BY by @KKould in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20239
* feat: meta: upgrade databend-meta to v260629.2.0, add raft protocol secret, compatible mode by @drmingdrmer in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20280
### Thoughtful Bug Fix 🔧
* fix(fuse): isolate partition and cluster layouts by @KKould in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20221
* fix(meta): disallow replacing tables with different engines by @zhyass in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20234
* fix(query): improve selectivity estimation for boolean expressions by @forsaken628 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20237
* fix(query): keep active temporary tables during vacuum by @SkyFan2002 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20254
* fix(query): prefer input columns in GROUPING arguments by @zhang2014 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20262
* fix(query): prevent temporary CTAS staging leaks by @zhyass in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20261
* fix(query): inherit function properties through aliases by @TCeason in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20255
* fix(sql): make GROUP BY name resolution column-first by @forsaken628 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20274
* fix(functions): support nullable calendar monotonicity by @zhang2014 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20271
### Code Refactor 🎉
* refactor(query): infer equality for singleton domains by @KKould in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20250
* refactor(query): defer expression collection and cloning by @KKould in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20253
* refactor: modularize and harden recluster orchestration by @zhyass in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/20258
### Build/Testing/CI Infra Changes 🔌

### Minor Changes

- [#23261](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink/pull/23261) [`9f65859`](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink/commit/9f65859dba91b912652644f0fe008cef281073fb) - Minor bump to start next version

### Patch Changes

- [#23284](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink/pull/23284) [`545a34e`](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink/commit/545a34e9ed063c6e5a1a3fe5827c06db0def1bd5) - #internal Confidential relay: on the workflow node, briefly wait (after attestation and Workflow-DON authorization pass) for a not-yet-registered execution handler before failing the enclave's relay callback. This lets a node that has not yet started its copy of the DON-shared execution register and sign in time, instead of failing the callback outright and eroding the relay quorum. The wait is bounded so a callback for an execution the node never runs still fails promptly.

releases.body:
## What's Changed
- **Drop official support for Python 3.8 and 3.9**. Both versions have reached their official End of Life (Python 3.8 in October 2024, Python 3.9 in October 2025). TinyDB now requires Python 3.10 or later.
- Fix: Make `Table.update(doc_ids=...)` and `Table.remove(doc_ids=...)` behave consistently with `Table.get(doc_id=...)` when given document IDs that don't exist: missing IDs are now silently skipped and the returned list only contains IDs that were actually updated/removed. Previously both methods raised `KeyError`, and `update` could leave the table in a partially-updated state when a mix of existing and missing IDs was passed (see #591).
- Fix: Prevent `TypeError` when passing unhashable extra arguments (like lists or dicts) to `Query.test()` (see #517).
- Fix: Prevent `FileNotFoundError` when creating a database file in the current directory without an explicit path prefix (see #619).
- Fix: Correctly handle falsy values (like `0` or `None`) stored in `LRUCache` (see #596).
- Improvement: More precise type hints for `Table.get` (see #602).
- Improvement: Correct the type hints for `Table.update` and `tinydb.operations` to use `MutableMapping`, so transform functions that modify documents in place type-check correctly (see #598).

* @epicblueprints made their first contribution in https://github.com/msiemens/tinydb/pull/597

releases.name: Apache HBase 3.0.0 is now available for download
releases.body:
The HBase team is happy to announce the immediate availability of HBase
3.0.0.

Apache HBase™ is an open-source, distributed, versioned, non-relational
database. Apache HBase gives you low latency random access to billions of rows
with millions of columns atop non-specialized hardware. To learn more about
HBase, see https://hbase.apache.org/.

HBase 3.0.0 is the first GA release for the 3.x release line, which includes
roughly 5000+ resolved issues since 2.0.0.

Notice that, starting from 3.0.0, we have moved up to JDK17. JDK8 and JDK11
support have been dropped.

Notable new features include:
  Synchronous Replication
  OpenTelemetry Tracing
  Distributed MOB Compaction
  Backup and Restore
  Decouple region replication and general replication framework, and also
    make region replication can work when SKIP_WAL is used
  A new file system based replication peer storage
  Use hbase table instead of zookeeper for tracking hbase replication queue

For other important changes:
  We do not support hadoop 2.x any more
  Move RSGroup balancer to core
  Reimplement sync client on async client
  CPEPs on shaded proto
  Move the logging framework from log4j to log4j2

#### Filter operators: literal wildcards and true case-insensitive equality

`$eqi` / `$nei` now do real case-insensitive equality (`= LOWER(?)`), not `LIKE`, so values with `%`, `_`, or a trailing `\` no longer act as wildcards or crash some databases. nocodb/nocodb.name: 2026.08.0 : Introducing Interfaces
nocodb/nocodb.body: ## Availability | Feature | CE / Free | Paid / Enterprise | |---|:---:|:---:| | Interfaces | – | ✅ | ## Interfaces **Interfaces** let you build custom, easy-to-use apps on top of your base data. Instead of giving everyone access to the full base with all its tables, views, and configuration options, you design focused pages that surface exactly the data and actions each audience needs: a review queue for approvers, a dashboard for leadership, a form for field teams, or a full internal tool that combines all of them. Your base remains the single source of truth; what changes is how each group experiences it. Interfaces (**beta**) are available on **NocoDB Cloud** (Plus plan and above) and licensed self-hosted deployments (Business plan and above). [Learn more about Interfaces →](https://nocodb.com/docs/interfaces) ## Improvements & Fixes - **Dynamic conditions in Record-Level Security.** A policy can now reference whoever is viewing the data, such as the current user, their email, or their teams, so a single policy like "Assignee is the current user" covers the whole workspace. Policies can also filter on system fields such as Created by and Last modified by. Available on NocoDB Cloud (Scale plan and above) and self-hosted Scale and Enterprise plans. [Learn more →](https://nocodb.com/docs/product-docs/roles-and-permissions/record-level-security) - **New WEEKNUM formula function.** `WEEKNUM(date, [startDayOfWeek])` returns the week of the year a date falls in, matching how spreadsheets calculate it. Weeks start on Sunday by default, and an optional second argument picks a different first day of the week. [Learn more →](https://nocodb.com/docs/product-docs/fields/field-types/formula/date-functions#weeknum) - **Select a range of rows with Shift+click.** Hold Shift while clicking a row's checkbox in the grid to select every row between it and the last row you clicked, the same way spreadsheets work. - **v3 link updates stay scoped to the requested records.** Updating a link field through the v3 records API no longer removes those linked records from other rows. - **Delete select options by title in API v3.** The field options delete endpoint now accepts option titles instead of ids and ignores titles that do not exist. Update existing v3 integrations accordingly. - **Behaviour change in API v1: user updates no longer change workspace access.** `PATCH /api/v1/users/{userId}` no longer changes default workspace access. To grant access to a specific base, use `POST /api/v3/meta/bases/{baseId}/members` with `{ email, base_role }`. To allow base creation and workspace-wide access, use `POST /api/v3/meta/workspaces/{workspaceId}/members` with `{ email, workspace_role }`. - **Grouped views stay put while editing.** Grids grouped by a link, user, JSON, or attachment field no longer blank out and reload on every cell edit. - **No more duplicate rows while scrolling.** When a record dropped out of a filtered or sorted grid, an in-flight fetch could render it a second time further down the view. - **Duplicating a record no longer moves linked records.** Copying every link verbatim could silently detach has-many and one-to-one linked records from the original. These links are now skipped on the copy, with a notice listing the fields that were not carried over. - **Faster views with QR codes.** QR code cells no longer generate full-size codes for every row, which could freeze views with many records. - **Snapshot reliability.** Snapshots now work on bases with restricted permissions and in workspaces that have reached their base limit. - **Smart Text fixes.** A failed initial load no longer lets autosave clear the cell's content, Backspace works again in the expanded editor, and tables show persistent bars for adding rows and columns. - **Rollup fields validate their target.** Creating a rollup over a field that cannot be aggregated, such as a Link, Lookup, or Button field, is rejected with a clear error instead of breaking every read of the table. - **Server-side scripts create records with data.** `createRecordsAsync` in scripts run by workflows and automations no longer creates blank records. - **Image viewer works in forms.** Opening an image attachment from a form no longer throws an error. - **List views load on external data sources** on NocoDB Cloud. - **Postgres imports keep auto-increment in sync.** After importing or migrating a base into Postgres, creating the first record no longer fails with a duplicate-key error. - **SQLite schema changes with indexes.** Deleting or modifying an indexed field on a connected SQLite database no longer fails. - **Sandbox feedback.** Creating a sandbox now confirms with a message instead of silently switching you over, and creating a document, which a sandbox does not support, is disabled with an explanation rather than failing on click. - **Tidier field visibility controls.** The fields panel in table details now uses an eye toggle to show or hide fields in the current view. - **Assorted stability fixes.** Right-clicking empty space on a Kanban board no longer shows another card's actions, and several crashes in select cells and the canvas grid were fixed. ## Security - **Input handling.** Stronger validation of filter expressions, redirect targets, connection configurations, and OAuth parameters across the platform. - **Data access controls.** Public share links, exports, and nested data now consistently honour view filters and hidden fields, and record-level security conditions are applied uniformly across data, realtime, and cached paths. - **Authentication and sessions.** Hardened session token rotation and OAuth authorization flows, and sign-in via identity providers now honours the provider's email verification status. - **Embedding protection.** NocoDB pages now send frame-protection headers, so only public share links can be embedded in other sites. - **Dependency updates.** Dependencies were updated against recently published advisories. ## Self-Hosting - **Change your license plan yourself.** Each license under **Account → Self-hosted licenses** on nocodb.com gets a detail page with its plan, billing period, editor count, renewal date, and invoices, plus a Change plan flow. Upgrades apply immediately with prorated billing; downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing period and can be reverted until then. [Learn more →](https://nocodb.com/docs/self-hosting/purchase-license) - **Hide paid features on unlicensed instances.** A new **Show only community edition features** preference under **Account → Profile** hides paid feature badges, upgrade prompts, and controls that only lead to an upgrade screen, so an instance running without a license shows just what it can actually do. The option appears only on unlicensed self-hosted instances. - **New configuration options.** Three `NC_AI_*` variables tune the AI assistant's token budgets: `NC_AI_TURN_TOKEN_BUDGET`, `NC_AI_INRUN_MICROCOMPACT_MIN_TOKENS`, and `NC_AI_TOOL_OUTPUT_SPILL_MAX_ENTRIES`. [Learn more →](https://nocodb.com/docs/self-hosting/environment-variables) --------- ### Closed issues - [**closed**] Missing standalone binary assets in releases (2026.06.2 and 2026.07.0) [#14325](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/14325) - [**closed**] Latest versions missing from npmjs [#14317](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/14317) - [**closed**] Can I make a video for nocodb docs? [#14315](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/14315) - [**closed**] 🐛 Bug: sync database no allowed [#14311](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/14311) - [**closed**] 🐛 Bug: Search filter not working on Link To Another Record (LTAR) fields [#14286](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/14286) - [**closed**] 🐛 Bug: xlsx import date field fails [#14275](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/14275) - [**closed**] 🐛 Bug: import excel column name with dot fails [#14200](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/14200) - [**closed**] 🐛 Bug: Date field silently fails on unpadded input (typing) and wipes data on paste [#14194](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/14194) - [**closed**] 🔦 Feature: SUM, AVG and other math functions on the formula field in Charts [#13032](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/13032) - [**closed**] 🔦 Feature: Allow for localized date format [#12545](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/12545) - [**🔦 Type: Feature**] 🔦 Feature: Add webhook trigger when adding a comment [#4558](https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/issues/4558)

makeplane/plane.name: v1.4.1
makeplane/plane.body:
### ✨  Features

#### **Workspace Member Reactivation Command**

Self-hosted administrators can now restore a deactivated workspace member straight from the command line, without editing the database by hand. Running `reactivate_workspace_member <workspace-slug> <email>` re-enables the membership and reports the role the member is restored to.

- Validates the workspace, the user, and the existing membership before changing anything, with a clear error when any of them is missing
- Safe to re-run — an already-active member is reported as such instead of failing
- Keeps audit fields intact by limiting the write to the membership's active state

### ⬆️  Enhancements

- The workspace-level modules list now returns the member IDs for each module, so module members and member-based filters render correctly on the workspace modules view.
- Work item layouts are now wrapped in an error boundary. If a single layout fails to render, it degrades to a local "Something went wrong" message with a Retry button instead of taking down the whole page.

### 🐞  Bug fixes

- Fixed notifications failing to load on self-hosted deployments, where a missing trailing slash on the notification list request surfaced as a 500 error behind the reverse proxy.
- Fixed filtering modules by member breaking for modules with no members assigned.
- Fixed the layout dropdown button being clipped and overlapping neighbouring controls in the Create View modal.
- Fixed crashes on work items whose labels included an ID that no longer resolves to a label, affecting the properties row, the spreadsheet label column, the peek overview, and draft work items.
- Fixed crashes when a response came back empty or in an unexpected shape, affecting description version history, previous exports, the integrations list, profile activity, and sub-work-items.
- Fixed the previous exports list failing to refresh, and surfaced an error instead of failing silently when the refresh does not go through.
- Fixed profile activity showing a loading state indefinitely instead of an empty state when a user had no activity.

### 🛡️ Security

- Hardened asset uploads on published Space pages. The endpoint previously trusted the client-supplied file size when signing the upload policy, allowing a caller to request a policy larger than the instance's configured `FILE_SIZE_LIMIT`. The size is now clamped to the instance limit and malformed values are rejected.
- Upgraded `cryptography` to 50.0.0 to close a high-severity PKCS#7 Bleichenbacher oracle.
- Upgraded React Router to 7.18.1, resolving denial-of-service, open redirect, cross-site scripting, and constructor injection advisories.
- Upgraded `sharp` to 0.35.3 to pick up high-severity libvips fixes.
- Resolved further high-severity advisories in `fast-uri` (host confusion), `js-yaml` (quadratic CPU denial of service), `linkify-it` (mailto validator denial of service), `postcss` (source map path traversal), and `undici` (information disclosure, CRLF and cookie injection).
- Resolved medium- and low-severity advisories in `sanitize-html` (URI scheme validation bypass), `valibot`, and `body-parser` (request limit bypass).

twentyhq/twenty.name: twenty/v2.30.0
twentyhq/twenty.body:
<!-- generated-release-notes v1 -->

## ⚠️ Breaking changes

- The GraphQL metadata API no longer uses nestjs-query cursor types. Remove ObjectConnection, FieldConnection, CursorPaging, and related cursor inputs from metadata queries and switch to the new resolver-based shape. ([#23925](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23925)) by @abdulrahmancodes
- Server image security update: undici bumped from v6/v7 to v8 (potentially breaking for direct callers), plus js-yaml, sharp, brace-expansion, ip-address, and dompurify patched for critical and high CVEs. Self-hosters should update. ([#23963](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23963)) by @charlesBochet

## 🌟 Highlights

- Hidden records no longer surface as chart labels through unfiltered relation joins. ([#23369](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23369))
- A new /chat mode keeps the conversation front and center with records opening as side-panel artifacts. ([#23929](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23929))
- Campaign email bodies now have a canvas editor with sections, columns, buttons, and image blocks. ([#23657](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23657))
- Views can now be displayed as a List, alongside table, board, and calendar. ([#23829](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23829))
- Records that no longer match an active filter disappear from the open table in real time. ([#23858](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23858))
- Opening and closing a currency field editor without typing no longer corrupts the stored amount. ([#23874](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23874))

## ✨ New features

- The runAgent API now accepts a messages array for multi-turn bot conversations alongside the existing single-prompt form. ([#23395](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23395)) by @abdulrahmancodes
- Apps can now run an agent on behalf of a specific workspace member, scoping the run to that person's permissions. ([#23470](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23470)) by @abdulrahmancodes

## ⚡ Performance

- Event-loop delay (mean, p50, p99, max) and workspace cache recompute times are now exported to Prometheus. ([#23751](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23751)) by @charlesBochet
- Per-pod workspace metadata cache occupancy — entry count, size, distinct workspaces, and per-provider bytes — is now tracked in Prometheus, with heavy providers capped by entry count. ([#23778](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23778)) by @charlesBochet
- AWS SDK clients now have an explicit request timeout; a stuck request can no longer exhaust the connection pool and hang the process. ([#23857](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23857)) by @charlesBochet
- V8 GC pause duration and heap metrics are now exported to Prometheus to help attribute high-p99 latency stalls to garbage collection. ([#23879](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23879)) by @charlesBochet
- A new IS_WORKSPACE_CACHE_COMPACT_STORAGE_ENABLED flag enables compacted cache payloads that reduce GC pressure on large deployments. ([#23880](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23880)) by @charlesBochet
- The workspace cache now tracks entry count per provider in Prometheus, making it possible to attribute memory growth to specific providers. ([#23883](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23883)) by @charlesBochet

## ⚠️ Breaking changes

- Remove any reference to `clientConfig.subdomainMinLength` — the field is deleted from `ClientConfig` in `twenty-client-sdk`. ([#23915](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23915)) by @ijreilly
- Cursor-pagination types from the metadata API (`FieldEdge`, `FieldFilter`, `CursorPaging`, `PageInfo`, `ConnectionCursor`, and comparison inputs) are removed; switch to the offset-based equivalents in the updated schema. ([#23925](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23925)) by @abdulrahmancodes

## 🌟 Highlights

- BREAKING: `subdomainMinLength` is removed from `ClientConfig` in `twenty-client-sdk` — drop any reference to `clientConfig.subdomainMinLength`. ([#23915](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23915))
- BREAKING: Cursor-pagination types from the metadata API (`FieldEdge`, `FieldFilter`, `CursorPaging`, `PageInfo`, `ConnectionCursor`) are removed following the nestjs-query migration. ([#23925](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23925))
- `runAgent` now accepts a `messages` array (alternating user/assistant turns) for multi-turn bot conversations; existing `prompt`-only calls are unchanged. ([#23395](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23395))
- `runAgent` can now execute on behalf of a specific workspace member, scoping the agent to that user's permissions. ([#23470](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23470))
- `CALL_RECORDING_SUMMARY` and `CALL_RECORDING_TRANSCRIPT` are registered as new widget types and appear in `twenty-client-sdk` generated types. ([#23864](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23864))

## ✨ New features

- Pass a `messages` array (alternating user/assistant turns) to `runAgent` for multi-turn bot conversations; the existing `prompt` field continues to work for one-shot calls. ([#23395](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23395)) by @abdulrahmancodes
- New option on `runAgent` lets your app execute an agent as a specific workspace member, capping the agent's permissions to that user's role. ([#23470](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23470)) by @abdulrahmancodes
- `CALL_RECORDING_SUMMARY` and `CALL_RECORDING_TRANSCRIPT` are now registered widget types; they appear in `twenty-client-sdk` generated type definitions. ([#23864](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23864)) by @ehconitin
- `User.isWorkspaceCreator` is now a resolved GraphQL field, accessible through `twenty-client-sdk` generated types. ([#23881](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23881)) by @bosiraphael

## 💅 Improvements & UX

- Minimum allowed subdomain length is now 1 character instead of 3; update any client-side subdomain validation that assumed the old floor. ([#23871](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23871)) by @ijreilly

## 🐛 Bug fixes

- Logic function layer builds no longer die with out-of-memory errors when an app bundles large packages such as `twenty-ui`. ([#23805](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23805)) by @charlesBochet

## ⚡ Performance

- Workspace metadata cache now uses compact storage behind a server flag, reducing GC pressure on heavy traffic; no API changes. ([#23880](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/23880)) by @charlesBochet

prisma/prisma.body:
# v8.0.0-rc.1

This is the first release on the v8 release-candidate line: releases are now versioned `8.0.0-rc.N` instead of `0.x` minors. It also makes every aggregate read back through the codec its target declares — `count()` returns a `bigint` — splits the SQL driver interface into a row-streaming call and a statistics call, and fixes four defects in query planning, emit, and driver error reporting.

## The v8 release-candidate line

Releases are now versioned `8.0.0-rc.1`, `8.0.0-rc.2`, and so on, with the counter advancing on every release. "The v8 RC" is the product name; the number underneath iterates freely, so there is no promise that the last RC before `8.0.0` final is numbered `rc.1`. There are no further `0.x` minors. The policy is written up in [`docs/oss/versioning.md`](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/blob/v8.0.0-rc.1/docs/oss/versioning.md). ([#29899](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29899))

For every package this repository publishes, `latest` keeps tracking the newest release, RC included. These package names have no pre-v8 stable audience to protect — a bare `npm install` of one of them was already an early-access install, and still is. The bare `prisma` package is not published from this repository; its v8 CLI shim lives in [prisma/prisma-cli](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-cli).

**Existing installs are not moved onto the RC line by `npm update`.** Lockfiles pin resolved versions, and a `^0.x` range can never match a `8.0.0-rc.N` pre-release, because pre-releases do not satisfy stable ranges. Only a fresh install, or an explicit version change on your side, lands on the RC.

Development builds move to the same line: every push to `main` that does not change the root version publishes `8.0.0-rc.X-dev.N` under the `dev` dist-tag.

**An RC respin may still contain breaking changes.** Until `8.0.0` final ships, the pre-1.0 latitude documented in [`docs/oss/versioning.md`](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/blob/v8.0.0-rc.1/docs/oss/versioning.md) carries over: a new `rc.N` may remove or rename APIs, change the semantics of existing ones, or change the contract format. Read the breaking-changes section of each release before you upgrade.

## Breaking changes

- **Aggregate results carry the codec their target declares** — an aggregate is now read back through the codec its target declares for that result rather than through whatever the driver handed over, so aggregate application types change. `count()` is a `bigint` on both PostgreSQL and SQLite, at the top level and inside an include, and an empty relation reads `0n`. On PostgreSQL, `sum` over `int2`/`int4` widens to a `bigint`, while `sum(int8)` and `avg` over any integer are `numeric` and read as exact decimal **strings**; `min`/`max` keep the column's own type, except over `varchar`, which returns `text`. On SQLite, `sum` over an integer column is a `bigint` and `avg` is always a `number`. Sweep your code for equality and arithmetic against an aggregate result (`count === 2` is false when `count` is `2n`) and for `JSON.stringify` over one (it throws on a bigint). `having(...)` operands are the exception and stay plain numbers — they are compared inside SQL and never cross a codec. Regenerate your contracts (`prisma-next contract emit`): `contract.d.ts` gains an `AggregateTypes` block that both the ORM and the SQL builder resolve result types from, and against an older contract an aggregate resolves to `never` in the ORM and `unknown` in the SQL builder. The type is not the only guard: an aggregate whose operation and input codec the composed target does not declare is rejected before the query runs, with the error code `ORM.AGGREGATE_UNSUPPORTED`. See the [upgrade recipe](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/blob/v8.0.0-rc.1/skills/prisma-next-upgrade/upgrades/0.17-to-8.0.0-rc.1/) and the [extension-author recipe](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/blob/v8.0.0-rc.1/skills/prisma-8-extension-upgrade/upgrades/0.17-to-8.0.0-rc.1/). ([#29867](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29867))

  Before:

  ```ts
  const rows = await posts.include('comments', (comments) => comments.count()).all();
  rows[0].comments === 2; // number; 0 when the relation is empty
  ```

  After:

  ```ts
  const rows = await posts.include('comments', (comments) => comments.count()).all();
  rows[0].comments === 2n; // bigint; 0n when the relation is empty
  ```

- **The SQL driver interface splits row streaming from statement statistics** — `SqlQueryable` (exported from `@internal/sql-relational-core/ast`) is now two methods wide: `query()` streams rows and `execute()` returns `{ affectedRows }`. The separate prepared-execution method is gone; a prepared plan is expressed by an optional `preparedStatementHandle` on the request instead, and a driver branches on whether that property is `undefined`. Application code, query results, and the contract format are unaffected — this only matters if you implement or wrap `SqlQueryable` yourself, in which case update your implementation to the two-method shape. There is no upgrade recipe entry for this; the change is the interface itself. ([#29907](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29907))

  Before:

  ```ts
  interface SqlQueryable {
    execute<Row>(request: SqlExecuteRequest): AsyncIterable<Row>;
    executePrepared<Row>(request: PreparedExecuteRequest): AsyncIterable<Row>;
    query<Row>(sql: string, params?: readonly unknown[]): Promise<SqlQueryResult<Row>>;
  }
  ```

  After:

  ```ts
  interface SqlQueryable {
    query<Row>(request: SqlExecuteRequest): AsyncIterable<Row>;
    execute(request: SqlExecuteRequest): Promise<SqlStatementStats>;
  }
  ```

## Features

- `prisma-next init` installs one `prisma-8` skill instead of eleven per-workflow skills, and removes the retired skill directories from every agent's install root on each run. Each skill is now installed by name — `prisma-8`, `prisma-next-upgrade`, and `prisma-8-extension-upgrade` — rather than by matching a wildcard against a directory, so a new skill landing beside them is not picked up by accident. ([#29853](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29853))

## Fixes

- A column, table, or model mapped to a name that is not a bare TypeScript identifier — `@map("has space")`, `@@map("data rows")` — now emits a quoted property key in `contract.d.ts` instead of producing a syntactically invalid file that killed `contract emit`. String literals in emitted TypeScript also survive control characters and line separators, which previously produced the same failure by a different route. ([#29889](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29889), [#29898](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29898))
- Nested `some`/`every`/`none` predicates over a self-referential relation now keep a distinct SQL alias at every level, so an inner scope no longer shadows the parent it is supposed to correlate against. This covers one-to-one, many-to-one, one-to-many, implicit many-to-many, and explicit-junction many-to-many relations in both directions, and relations whose physical tables share a bare name across namespaces. ([#29900](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29900))
- Scalar reducers on a many-to-many include — `count()`, `sum()`, `avg()`, `min()`, `max()` — now traverse the junction table instead of emitting a predicate against a foreign-key column that only exists on the junction, so a filtered relation count over a many-to-many relation returns the right number. ([#29888](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29888))
- A failed retry of a stale PostgreSQL prepared statement now surfaces a structured error envelope with the code `DRIVER.PREPARE_FAILED`, carrying the normalized driver error as its cause, instead of an unlabelled failure. ([#29907](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29907))

prisma/prisma.name: v0.17.0
prisma/prisma.body:
# v0.17.0

This is the namespace release: Prisma Next now publishes as 17 packages under the `@prisma` scope, and an application depends on exactly one database facade. It also completes the structured error-code scheme across every plane, makes relation-loading lossless for big numbers and temporal values, and gives every SQL index and RLS policy an exact, migratable name.

## Breaking changes

- **One `@prisma` package per application** — the `@prisma-next/*` scope is retired; nothing publishes under it again. An application depends on exactly one database facade — `@prisma/orm-postgres`, `@prisma/orm-sqlite`, or `@prisma/orm-mongo` — plus any extension packs it uses (now named `@prisma/orm-extension-*`); everything else arrives as the facade's exact-pinned dependencies. Regenerating your contract rewrites generated imports to facade entrypoints with no `contractHash` change. See the [0.16-to-0.17 upgrade recipe](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/blob/v0.17.0/skills/upgrade/prisma-next-upgrade/upgrades/0.16-to-0.17/) and the [extension-author recipe](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/blob/v0.17.0/skills/extension-author/prisma-8-extension-upgrade/upgrades/0.16-to-0.17/). ([#29864](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29864), [#29880](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29880), [#29883](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29883), [#29884](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29884))

  Before:

  ```jsonc
  "dependencies": {
    "@prisma-next/postgres": "0.16.0",
    "@prisma-next/framework-components": "0.16.0",
    "@prisma-next/sql-runtime": "0.16.0"
  }
  ```

  After:

  ```jsonc
  "dependencies": {
    "@prisma/orm-postgres": "0.17.0"
  }
  ```

- **Every published error is a structured envelope with a dotted code** — the four legacy error systems (`PN-CLI-4001`-style codes, `RUNTIME.DECODE_FAILED`-style codes, and codeless error classes) consolidate into one scheme: a structural envelope carrying a `NAMESPACE.SUBCODE` code, recognized by the `isStructuredError` type predicate instead of `instanceof`. The ORM, contract-authoring, adapter/target, extension, and framework planes are all swept; legacy error classes (`PslFormatError`, the Supabase and SQL-escape classes, framework classes) are deleted. Prisma 7's `P1001`-style codes are not carried over. ([#1016](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1016), [#1021](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1021), [#1025](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1025), [#1049](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1049), [#1053](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1053), [#1063](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1063))

  Before:

  ```ts
  if (error instanceof PslFormatError) {
    report(error.diagnostics);
  }
  ```

  After:

  ```ts
  if (isStructuredError(error) && error.code === 'PSL.PARSE_FAILED') {
    report(error.meta.diagnostics);
  }
  ```

- **Content hashes are bare hex** — the `sha256:` prefix is gone from every surface (emitted contracts, migration manifests, refs, CLI output, and the database marker), and loaders reject the prefixed form. Contract hash values are unchanged; `migrationHash` values change. A codemod in the [0.16-to-0.17 recipe](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/blob/v0.17.0/skills/upgrade/prisma-next-upgrade/upgrades/0.16-to-0.17/) converts checked-in migration trees. ([#1033](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1033))

- **Migration contract snapshots move into a content-addressed store** — per-migration sibling snapshot files and ref-paired copies are replaced by a single `migrations/snapshots/<hex>/` store per migrations root; every distinct contract is stored once, and `migration.ts` imports its bookend contracts from the store. This is a clean break with no fallback reader; a one-shot migrator (`scripts/migrate-migrations-layout.mjs`) converts existing trees and re-verifies every `migrationHash` unchanged. ([#1018](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1018), [#1024](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1024))

- **PostgreSQL native types are authored in type position; the `@db.*` attribute channel is removed** — write the native type directly (`VarChar(255)`, `Uuid`, `Timestamptz`) instead of a base type plus `@db.*` attribute; remaining `@db.X(args)` usage fails with the exact replacement spelled out. `Json` re-binds to native `json` storage, with a new `Jsonb` scalar for jsonb (what every pre-0.16 `Json` field meant — switch those fields to keep a byte-identical contract), and `Date` re-binds to the correct `pg/date@1` codec. ([#1022](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1022), [#1036](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1036), [#1054](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1054))

  Before:

  ```prisma
  model User {
    id    String @id @db.Uuid
    name  String @db.VarChar(255)
  }
  ```

  After:

  ```prisma
  model User {
    id    Uuid         @id
    name  VarChar(255)
  }
  ```

- **Relation-loading and aggregates are lossless** — values read through `.include()` no longer pass through lossy JSON: every codec gains an explicit lossless JSON form produced inside the database. 64-bit integers arrive as `bigint` instead of silently rounding, decimals as exact strings, and temporal columns decode correctly. Aggregate result types change accordingly: `count()` is a `bigint`, decimal sums are strings. Regenerate your contract after upgrading. ([#29844](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29844), [#1023](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1023), [#1051](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1051))

- **SQL indexes and RLS policies are name-identified** — every index and RLS policy carries an exact name in the contract, names travel on the wire, live objects can be adopted by exact name (`@@map`), and a rename converges by renaming instead of drop-and-recreate. ([#1047](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1047), [#29807](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29807), [#29865](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29865))

- **`extensionPacks` config key renamed to `extensions`** — in `prisma-next.config.ts`, the TS builder, client options, and the emitted contract's top-level key. The old key fails loudly. Because the key sits in the hashed contract bytes, all contract hashes change: re-emit and re-anchor migrations per the recipe. Two smaller key renames ride along: `contract.source.sourceFormat` → `format`, and the facade `defineConfig` option `outputPath` → `output`. ([#1032](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1032))

- **Count-only mutation terminals renamed** — `createCount(...)` / `updateCount(...)` / `deleteCount()` become `createAndCount(...)` / `updateAndCount(...)` / `deleteAndCount()`; behavior and `Promise<number>` results are unchanged, with no compatibility aliases. ([#1044](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1044))

## Features

- Expression, partial, and unique indexes are authorable in both PSL and the TypeScript builder. ([#1048](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1048))
- `contract infer` reaches full fidelity — indexes, policy blocks, and `@@rls` are captured — and signs the database, so introspect-then-verify works end to end on an adopted database. It also infers 1:1 relations from unique indexes. ([#29808](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29808), [#1038](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1038))
- Every error code is documented on an in-repo reference page (221 codes), kept complete by a CI check, and error envelopes carry a `docsUrl` pointing at their per-code anchor. ([#1027](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1027), [#29806](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29806))

## Fixes

- MongoDB write results decode through their type codecs instead of returning raw wire values. ([#29879](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29879))
- The Postgres runtime driver serializes queries per pinned client, fixing interleaved-query failures on a shared connection. ([#29839](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29839))
- Mixed-case native-enum casts are quoted, so PascalCase enum type names survive Postgres case-folding. ([#1034](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1034))
- Driver cursor streaming runs inside an explicit transaction, fixing dropped-portal failures under load. ([#1017](https://github.com/prisma/prisma-next/pull/1017))
- Published type declarations name only dependencies a consumer will actually have installed. ([#29862](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/pull/29862))
